annotations.title: Get a company's directors and shareholders

description: The register of directors and the register of members of one of the signed-in customer's companies: each director's name, nationality, type and appointment date (and former directors), and each shareholder's name, nationality (a company's country of incorporation), whether it's an individual or a company, and its shares by class with its percentage of the company. you marks the customer. No identity numbers or contact details are available here.
name: get_company_registers
title: Get a company's directors and shareholders
